description: Get analytics for your own listings over the last 7, 30 or 90 days: total views, clicks, downloads, sales and USD earned, the same numbers per day and per listing, and the previous period's views for comparison. Use it to see which listings perform; use get_balance for money you are owed and get_sales for individual orders. Read-only. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

days.description: Length of the period ending today: 7, 30 (default) or 90 days. views_previous_period covers the same length just before it.

name: get_stats
title: Listing stats
